## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Diff is scoped and understandable
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] Automated checks pass
- [ ] No secrets or real citizen data are present

- [ ] Planned, implemented, tested, integrated, and production-ready states are not conflated
